family_reports.body: My children’s childhood was stolen from them. They were taken on false allegations over 3 years. Which were all determined unsubstantiated- they still have not returned home. They have been withheld court ordered therapy treatment for 3 years with no enforcement that could help them heal

The Kansas court system is so corrupt. It’s not even funny and judge Mativi is my judge . She awarded custody to someone who had no witnesses when I had five witnesses saying he smoked marijuana with my kids in the room and abused me and the children.
